good: Boost trails and sideways drift give useful feedback.
Clear speed, boost, rival distance, and takedown counter.
Sunset skyline and varied traffic fill the highway.
bad: Repeated box buildings and crude cars limit visual quality.
Frequent crashes and an offscreen car disrupt driving.
Trailer records one takedown but does not clearly show the decisive impact.
gpt-6.1-sol-high.one_line: It looks like a working arcade racer, but the boxy world and repeated crashes fall short of Burnout's speed and impact.

good: Camera stays locked behind the car through drift and boost; controls all respond correctly
HUD is genuinely Burnout-like: big italic speed, segmented boost bar that drains/refills, takedown counter, rival distance banner
Trailer packs boosts, rival wreck, crash respawn and drift into 28s of clear moment-to-moment beats
bad: World is pure boxes with white-square debris particles; buildings repeat and there's little roadside detail
Idle vs gas motion energy nearly identical (17.5 vs 17.6) — weak raw speed feedback beyond the speedo numbers
Takedown reads as a small 'RIVAL WRECKED' banner instead of the punchy 'TAKEDOWN!' the brief asked for
step-5-preview.one_line: A coherent low-poly Burnout slice with a strong HUD and working takedowns, but the box city and square debris keep it from feeling fast and real.
